heading: Travel Services
intro: Every trip starts with a conversation. Here's where I help most — tell me what you have in mind and I'll build the details around it.

categories.title: Disney & Theme Parks
categories.who: For families who want the magic without the spreadsheet.
categories.body: Park days, dining reservations, resort strategy, and timing it around crowds and weather — Disney and Universal trips have a lot of moving parts, and most of the stress comes from having to sequence them yourself. I do that part, so the trip feels like a holiday rather than a logistics project.

categories.title: Cruises
categories.who: For travelers who want to see several places and unpack once.
categories.body: Ships vary enormously — family-friendly megaships, quiet adults-only lines, small river vessels. The cabin category and deck position matter more than most people expect, and so does the itinerary's pace. I help you match the ship to how you actually like to travel, not just to the lowest headline fare.

categories.title: All-Inclusive Resorts
categories.who: For anyone who wants to arrive and stop making decisions.
categories.body: Show up and it's handled — dining, drinks, activities, often airport transfers. The catch is that "all-inclusive" means very different things at different properties. I help you find one that matches your vibe, whether that's quiet and romantic or full of things for kids to do.

categories.title: Weddings & Honeymoons
categories.body: Beachfront ceremony, intimate elopement, or a celebration with guests flying in from everywhere. I coordinate the travel side — including your guests' bookings — and plan the honeymoon alongside it, so travel is one less thing on a list that's already long.
